blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines could lose up to P603 billion annually, or nearly 3% of its gross domestic product (GDP), to fraud involving money mule accounts, according to a joint whitepaper by trust tech company IDfy Philippines and Filipino credit bureau CIBI Information Inc. The report, “Mule Hunting: Are We Chasing Ghosts?,” examined Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas data showing that PESONet and InstaPay processed a combined P24.74 trillion in transaction flows in 2025. The study also noted that fewer than 2% of cybercrimes are formally reported, allowing mule accounts to remain active and available for repeated fraudulent transactions for months. […]...
